usage: ‘燈’ is commonly used as a noun to refer to any device that emits light.
It can be used in both singular and plural contexts, like '一盞燈' (one lamp) or '好多燈' (many lamps).
The word can be combined with other words to specify the type of lamp, such as ‘吊燈’ (chandelier) or ‘檯燈’ (desk lamp).
‘燈’ can be part of phrases describing its function or feature, for example, ‘開燈’ means to turn on the light.
In some contexts, ‘燈’ may also refer to traffic lights, e.g., ‘交通燈’.
